text:
marta: Heads-up — saw ~30 customer reports this morning where the SSE stream ends early and console shows 'snapshot incomplete'. Happens after a route reshuffle during a long chat response.

sam: Can you paste logs? Is it a 499 from the client or backend closed stream?

marta: Logs show connection stayed open, then our proxy sent an upstream `EOF` when we moved the request to another pool. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:14Z] proxy: sticky=false route=low-cost -> migrate to pool-3
[2026-03-18T09:12:14Z] proxy: upstream EOF while streaming token=abcd...
[2026-03-18T09:12:14Z] runtime: emitted final-event id=evt_987 incomplete=true
```

joel: That matches: routing decision triggered mid-request. We currently do non-sticky routing for cost-based policies and do a hard handoff. Bad idea for streaming.

anya: Customers see truncated responses in Console and then a duplicate billing event for the same user request in the dashboard — looks like retry logic fires.

telemetry-bot: metric spike: sse.partial_streams +420% between 09:10-09:20 UTC, correlated with route-policy=cost_burst.

sam: Two problems: 1) handoff causes EOF and leaves the client without a terminal marker, 2) our client SDK retries on ambiguous end leading to duplicate completion events.

marta: Proposed mitigation: make routing sticky for any connection that has emitted >0 tokens until we get an explicit final event or a timeout. Also add a server-side 'final-ack' token so SDKs can reliably detect completed streams.

joel: Sticky routing buys safety but reduces burst migration benefits. Maybe make sticky only when seq_len > 0 or when KV cache warmed. Also add a 250ms grace drain before killing upstream to let final token propagate.

anya: From a Console UX POV we need to avoid 'snapshot incomplete' noise. If we introduce final-ack, Console can hide incomplete state until ack timeout. Add a rollout toggle in Console for 'stream final-ack' so we can flip per-tenant.

sam: Implementation sketch: 
```
// runtime: when about to change route
if (streaming && emitted_tokens > 0) {
  route.sticky = true;
  drain(250ms); // wait for final-event or timeout
}

// protocol: final-event
{ "type": "final-event", "id": "evt_987", "checksum": "..." }
```

marta: Also need telemetry: count handoffs that caused EOF, handoffs allowed (with drain), and SDK-detected retries. Telemetry-bot: add metric names?

telemetry-bot: added metrics: sse.handoff_eof_count, sse.handoff_drain_success, sse.sdk_retry_count. Dashboard tile under Streaming > Handoffs created.

joel: For rollout: start with 5% of traffic on cost_burst policy for sticky+drain, observe sse.partial_streams and sdk_retry_count for 24h. If good, expand.

marta: Who owns SDK change for final-ack? We need a small version bump and semantics: if final-event seen, SDK must not retry.

sam: I'll file PRs: runtime sticky+drain and server final-event emitter. @marta can you open the Console rollout toggle patch? @anya can you own customer messaging?

marta: Yep. Opening Console PR and rollout plan now.

anya: I'll draft a brief support note and a changelog blurb. Keep wording: "improves reliability of long streams and reduces duplicate completions".

deploy-bot: deploy queued for runtime/pr-4324 (sticky routing) -> staging.

sam: Quick follow-up: we should also add a verification in the billing pipeline to dedupe completions by request_id+final_checksum to avoid immediate duplicates if SDKs misbehave.

joel: Agreed. I'll add a small idempotency filter in billing job.

marta: Thanks — I'll monitor telemetry tile after staging rollout. If anything spikes ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
